name: io.github.lm203688/aishield
title: AIShield Security Scanner
description: Pre-flight security scan for any MCP server, AI skill, or agent. 214 MCP rules + 220 skill rules aligned to OWASP MCP Top 10 + OWASP Agentic AI Top 10 (ASI01–ASI10). Local-first, no code leaves your machine. Provides aishield_scan (full audit), aishield_guardrail (install any MCP safely), aishield_prompt_check (injection probe), aishield_banned_words (content gate), aishield_rug_pull (provenance drift detector), aishield_handshake (remote endpoint probe).
